description: Start a conformance run against an endpoint registered on this account, the sandbox or your own: one module, or every module the endpoint offers. Returns the report id at once. Against your own endpoint it needs the Integrate plan, and a module sold on a higher plan names it. Answers: does my endpoint conform to OCPI.

module.description: One module to grade, at the endpoint's OCPI version; chargerdojo_list_checks lists its checks. Omit to grade every module the endpoint offers.

retryKey.description: A key of your choosing for this run. Calling again with the same key returns the run it started instead of starting another. Omit it to start a new run on every call.

targetId.description: The registered endpoint to run against, from chargerdojo_list_targets.

name: chargerdojo_start_conformance_run
title: Start a conformance run
